mapper.select: SELECT P.PostID, P.AuthorID, P.Content, P.ImageURL AS imageUrl, P.CreatedAt, P.UpdatedAt, P.LikesCount, P.RepostsCount, P.ReplyToPostID, U.NAME AS authorName, U.ID AS handle, NULL AS profileImage FROM T_TRACE_POSTS P JOIN T_USER U ON P.AuthorID = U.ID ORDER BY P.CreatedAt DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_TRACE_POSTS ( PostID, AuthorID, Content, ImageURL, CreatedAt ) VALUES ( T_TRACE_POSTS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{authorId}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT P.PostID, P.AuthorID, P.Content, P.ImageURL AS imageUrl, P.CreatedAt, P.UpdatedAt, P.LikesCount, P.RepostsCount, P.ReplyToPostID, U.NAME AS authorName, NULL AS profileImage, U.ID AS handle FROM T_TRACE_POSTS P JOIN T_USER U ON P.AuthorID = U.ID WHERE P.Content LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY P.CreatedAt DESC

mapper.select: SELECT n.NotificationID, n.UserID, n.Type, n.ReferenceID, n.IsRead, n.CreatedAt, ( CASE n.Type WHEN 'mention' THEN ( SELECT c.WriterID FROM T_TRACE_MENTIONS m JOIN T_TRACE_COMMENTS c ON c.CommentID = m.CommentID WHERE m.MentionID = n.ReferenceID ) WHEN 'like' THEN (SELECT l.UserID FROM T_TRACE_LIKES l WHERE l.LikeID = n.ReferenceID) WHEN 'retweet' THEN (SELECT r.UserID FROM T_TRACE_REPOSTS r WHERE r.RepostID = n.ReferenceID) WHEN 'follow' THEN (SELECT f.FollowerID FROM T_TRACE_FOLLOWS f WHERE f.FollowID = n.ReferenceID) END ) AS ACTOR_USER_ID, ( SELECT u.NAME FROM T_USER u WHERE u.ID = ( CASE n.Type WHEN 'mention' THEN ( SELECT c.WriterID FROM T_TRACE_MENTIONS m JOIN T_TRACE_COMMENTS c ON c.CommentID = m.CommentID WHERE m.MentionID = n.ReferenceID ) WHEN 'like' THEN (SELECT l.UserID FROM T_TRACE_LIKES l WHERE l.LikeID = n.ReferenceID) WHEN 'retweet' THEN (SELECT r.UserID FROM T_TRACE_REPOSTS r WHERE r.RepostID = n.ReferenceID) WHEN 'follow' THEN (SELECT f.FollowerID FROM T_TRACE_FOLLOWS f WHERE f.FollowID = n.ReferenceID) END ) ) AS ACTOR_NICKNAME, ( CASE n.Type WHEN 'mention' THEN (SELECT m.PostID FROM T_TRACE_MENTIONS m WHERE m.MentionID = n.ReferenceID) WHEN 'like' THEN (SELECT l.PostID FROM T_TRACE_LIKES l WHERE l.LikeID = n.ReferenceID) WHEN 'retweet' THEN (SELECT r.PostID FROM T_TRACE_REPOSTS r WHERE r.RepostID = n.ReferenceID) WHEN 'follow' THEN NULL END ) AS POST_ID FROM T_TRACE_NOTIFICATIONS n WHERE n.UserID = #{id} ORDER BY n.CreatedAt DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
